title: Deterministic automation authority
summary: Agents MUST use declared repository automation for deterministic operations and MUST NOT reproduce the same operation manually.
instructions: When the active invocation declares an automation requirement, the agent MUST invoke the named automation. The agent MUST use the declared target and the declared arguments before the affected operation.

Agents MUST treat durable repository automation as authoritative over ad hoc shell sequences or per-run scripts. Agents MUST NOT manually recreate its behavior unless the requirement declares an explicit fallback.

When no durable automation exists, an agent MAY create a task-specific script under runtime/logs/workflows/<run-id>/scripts/ only for the current run. The agent SHOULD test the core behavior and likely edge cases of that script before it relies on that script.

An agent MUST report a missing executable, non-zero exit, timeout, malformed result, or target mismatch as an automation failure. The agent MUST then follow the requirement's declared failure route. Agents MUST NOT bypass the failure by asserting an equivalent manual result.
The agent MUST record the exact command, target, result, and evidence path for every required automation invocation.
Harness-owned operations and gates MUST remain harness-owned even when an agent runs the same automation for early feedback.
